lines.text: Daniel learned from the sacred books that Jerusalem's desolation would last seventy years, so he prayed with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
Daniel confessed that they had not listened to the priests, and that the curse written in the Law of Moses was poured out.
Daniel reminded God that He brought His people out of Egypt, and asked that His anger turn away from Jerusalem.
While Daniel was still praying, Michael came in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice to give him insight.
Gabriel said seventy weeks are decreed to put an end to sin, and that the one who confirms a covenant will end sacrifice and offering.
